units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:1:10">Y. Sot. I, 16ᶜ</cite> top <he>ש׳ אחת</he> one hair; a. e.—Pl. <he>שׂעֲרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:1:10">Ib.</cite>, a. fr. <he>שתי ש׳</he> (not <cite ref="U01585"><he>שני</he></cite>) two hairs (symptom of maturity).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20:11">Lev. R. s. 20</cite> <he>מעולם לא ראו … ש׳ ראשי</he> the beams of my house never saw the hair of my head (v. <cite ref="S01395"><he>קֶלַע</he> II</cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:22">Y. Yoma I, 38ᵈ</cite> top; a. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:2:2">Y. Ter. I, 40ᵈ</cite> top <he>ש׳ של אורז</he> (ed. Krot. <cite ref="U01642"><he>שְׂעוֹרָה</he></cite>) the panicles of rice.
